meta.title: Two-round event: a submitted regret blocks quoting that line again
gaps: The vocabulary has no operation for regretting or declining a line item, so the setup does not create the required submitted-regret state.
The plan cannot verify that the fresh bid opens before pricing is refused.
warnings: error code 736 is not in en-IN.yml (or the backend checkout is missing) — the message cannot be checked

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFP + RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted its technical response; rounds still open.
steps: The invited QA vendor opens a bid on the pricing round.
The invited QA vendor prices the line on the bid.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You have declined to provide this line item; therefore, you are not permitted to quote for it commercially”, and never with a server error.
